newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Sheremetyevo airport completes runway repair.
newsitem.headline: Sheremetyevo airport completes runway repair.

text.p: Sheremetyevo airport has completed the modernisation of its main runway, an official said on Friday.
The airport's general director Sergey Sutulov told Reuters that the runway start operating at the beginning of 1997 after eight years of repairs.
"Currently, aircraft are making technical take-offs and landings on the runway as part of routine technical checks," Sutulov said.
He also said the airport will be able to accept more planes once the runway is open.
Sheremetyevo airport has two runways, two passenger terminals and a set of cargo facilities.
Sutulov said there were no plans to close the second runway for modernisation as Russian media had reported.
